_help: Record a facility's identity here ONLY after a person has confirmed it from a public record. Nothing in this file is inferred or generated.
Each entry needs: rto, queue_id, verified_label, confirmed_by, confirmed_on (YYYY-MM-DD) and at least one evidence item with a citation (url is optional but recommended).

verified_label must be one of: Confirmed Data Center Campus | Confirmed Industrial Park / Manufacturing | Confirmed Utility / Distribution Load Growth | Confirmed Cryptocurrency Mining | Confirmed Other Large Load | Ruled Out (Duplicate / Withdrawn / Data Error)
Optional per entry: verified_operator, notes. Optional per evidence item: accessed_on, type.
See ground_truth_overrides.example.json for a complete (fictional) entry. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored.
A malformed file stops investigate_ambiguous_loads.py with exit code 2 and lists every problem. Overrides change only the dossier, not the CSVs or index.html.
